MOD = 1000000007

def fastpow(a, b):
    ans = 1
    while b:
        if b & 1:
            ans = (ans * a) % MOD
        a = (a * a) % MOD
        b >>= 1
    return ans

def main():
    import sys
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not input_data:
        return
    it = iter(input_data)
    n = int(next(it))
    p = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    inv = fastpow(100, MOD - 2)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            p[i][j] = int(next(it))
            p[i][j] = (p[i][j] * inv) % MOD

    sub = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    id = [[-1] * (1 << n) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    for sz in range(n + 1):
        for mask in range(1 << n):
            if bin(mask).count('1') == sz:
                id[sz][mask] = len(sub[sz])
                sub[sz].append(mask)

    dp = [{} for _ in range(n + 1)]
    dp[0][1] = 1

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for s in range(1 << n):
            pr = 1
            for j in range(n):
                if s & (1 << j):
                    pr = (pr * p[i - 1][j]) % MOD
                else:
                    pr = (pr * (1 - p[i - 1][j] + MOD)) % MOD

            for f, count in dp[i - 1].items():
                new_mask = 0
                for t in sub[i]:
                    tmp = t
                    while tmp:
                        low = tmp & -tmp
                        j = (low.bit_length() - 1)
                        if (s & low) and (f & (1 << id[i - 1][t ^ low])):
                            new_mask |= (1 << id[i][t])
                            break
                        tmp ^= low
                dp[i][new_mask] = (dp[i].get(new_mask, 0) + count * pr) % MOD

    print(dp[n][1])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
